## Quick answers
- Gold rate today in India: 22K ₹12,730/g, 24K ₹13,887/g, 18K ₹10,415/g (middle of 36 jewellers' published rates, before 3% GST). https://mygoldrates.com/
- Cheapest jeweller for gold today: D.P. Jewellers, 22K ₹12,632/g, 24K ₹13,780/g. Dearest: Ranka Jewellers, 24K ₹14,422/g. https://mygoldrates.com/gold-rate-by-jeweller
- Price of 10 grams of 22K today: about ₹127,300 before GST, ₹131,119 with 3% GST, plus making charges (typically 8-25% of the gold value, by design). https://mygoldrates.com/making-charges-comparison
- 1 tola (11.664 g) of 24K today: about ₹161,981 before GST.
- Billed price = gold value + making charge + 3% GST on both (+ hallmarking, Rs 45 a piece).

## Tools
- Ask Sona, the free jewellery assistant on every page, in 13 Indian languages: best offer by jewel, an approximate bill at any jeweller (gold + making after offer + GST).
- Jewellers Digest: a daily gold market outlook (direction for the week, month and quarter, expected range, key levels), free until Dhanteras (6 Nov 2026), then Rs 499/month. https://mygoldrates.com/jewellers-digest
- Calculators: https://mygoldrates.com/calculators  Daily email alerts: https://mygoldrates.com/inquiry

## About the data
Each jeweller's rate is the one it publishes on its own website that day; every karat is worked out
from its 22K rate (or the highest purity it publishes). Pre-GST, per gram. Methodology:
https://mygoldrates.com/methodology. Rates are indicative and change during the day; confirm with the jeweller
before buying. Not investment advice.
